class.name: CbLaunch
class.brief_description: Throws an item of a kind into the world when its motion starts: a grenade, a ball, a rocket.
class.description: A child of a [CbMotion] (not for a While). On the tick the motion starts, every simulation makes an item of [member item_kind] in front of the player, moving at [member speed] along [member frame] with [member lift] upward and the player's own velocity. Because the thrower's own simulation makes it from the thrower's own input, it leaves on the tick of the press, with no round trip; it then flies and bounces as its body says ([CbItem], [CbBody]), the same in every simulation. It is an item like any other: its scene is drawn wherever it is, its reactions play, it can be picked up (unless its kind says no), and it counts against the server's caps on what a player may leave in the world. What a hit means is the server mod's: it sees what the item ran into, how fast and where, and who threw it. Give the motion a [code]cooldown[/code] or [code]uses[/code], or the key throws as fast as it can be pressed.

members.member: The item kind thrown ([code]grenade.shell[/code]): one a server mod declares and a [CbItem] bakes. One no mod declares: nothing is thrown, and the server says so when it starts.
Metres per second upward, added: an arc.
For [constant FRAME_WORLD]: the direction, as given.
How far in front of where the player's look starts it begins, in metres: clear of the thrower's own body.
When it is removed again. 0: it stays, like anything dropped.

constants.constant: Where the camera looks, pitch included.
Where the move keys point, relative to the camera; the facing when none is held.
